title: Answer: human and animal consciousness, from simpler consciousness

statements.text: Human and animal consciousness is not fundamental: it is grounded in more basic consciousness, on constitutive views, or emerges from it, on emergentist views, and Strawson holds that this emergence is as intelligible as liquidity from molecules. The physical world described by physics is the outward structure of the same reality.

sources.quote: is not fundamental but is grounded in a more fundamental form of consciousness which is ubiquitous throughout nature
the notion of emergence begins to recover some respectability in its application to the case of experience
